findings.title: NtfsAudit.Service depends on NtfsAudit.App WPF project
findings.summary: The headless Windows service references the WPF application project, pulling UI concerns into daemon/runtime and test boundaries.
findings.target_outcome: Introduce NtfsAudit.Core and make Service depend on Core instead of App.

findings.title: PathKind.Nfs declares unsupported NFS behavior
findings.summary: The code classifies some paths as NFS but does not implement native NFS or POSIX ACL scanning.
findings.target_outcome: Remove the false NFS contract and document only Windows-exposed path behavior.

findings.title: Credential model documentation uses incorrect fallback terminology
findings.summary: Local paths are forced to CurrentUser by policy; this is not a fallback.
findings.target_outcome: Document the effective credential policy, DPAPI scopes, service mode, and credential isolation guarantees.

findings.title: .ntaudit archive contract is undocumented and partially inconsistent
findings.summary: analysis.sqlite is mandatory in exported archives, but documentation implies optional large-archive behavior.
findings.target_outcome: Document ZIP entries, archive versioning, SQLite contract, import compatibility, and credential stripping.

findings.title: PathResolver DFS caches are static and unbounded
findings.summary: Long-running service processes can accumulate DFS cache entries without TTL or eviction.
findings.target_outcome: Add TTL-based lazy eviction with regression tests.

findings.title: MainViewModel contains scan orchestration logic
findings.summary: Scan orchestration is tightly coupled to WPF ViewModel state and is hard to test outside UI context.
findings.target_outcome: Track as follow-up refactoring candidate after Core extraction.

findings.title: build.ps1 is a redundant wrapper around compile.ps1
findings.summary: Build entrypoint documentation and CI usage should be checked and made consistent.
findings.target_outcome: Keep one canonical command path documented, with wrapper behavior explicit if retained.

findings.title: Nullable Reference Types are disabled
findings.summary: Nullable type safety is currently not enforced.
findings.target_outcome: Consider progressive nullable enablement as separate approved debt work.

findings.title: AGENTS.md missing from current HEAD
findings.summary: Agent-assisted development guidance appears to have been removed from the working tree.
findings.target_outcome: Restore AGENTS.md from history if still intended.

findings.title: No .editorconfig
findings.summary: Code style is not enforced by a repository-level editor configuration.
findings.target_outcome: Consider adding .editorconfig as optional debt work.

findings.title: Existing features are under-documented
findings.summary: PowerShell fallback, advanced audit, group membership export, and baseline comparison need documentation.
findings.target_outcome: Document implemented features without overstating support.

findings.title: Coverage gaps in critical contracts
findings.summary: Credential isolation, legacy archive import, DFS behavior, ScanWorker lifecycle, and share permission positive retrieval need stronger coverage.
findings.target_outcome: Add focused tests around privacy, compatibility, and service/core boundaries.

paths_supported: Local Windows paths such as C:\path\to\folder
DFS namespace paths resolved through Windows DFS APIs
Extended Windows paths such as \\?\C:\... and \\?\UNC\server\share\...
Mapped drives resolved to UNC through Windows APIs
NAS paths exposed through SMB/CIFS providers
paths_unsupported: Native NFS paths such as nfs://server/export
Native Linux/POSIX paths and POSIX ACL scanning
Cloud object storage without a Windows filesystem mount

notes: analysis.sqlite is mandatory even for small archives.
Archives with version 5 or later require strict count validation.
Archives with version 1 or 2 are legacy and require tolerant import.

credential_policy.note: Mandatory policy override; Global credentials are ignored.
Separate from interactive App credential store.

permission_model: Effective permissions as NTFS and share permission intersection
